label: rem:wedderburn-as-noncomm-fourier-context
title: The mass formula as an inverse non-commutative Fourier transform
html:
The Wedderburn-Artin decomposition maps the Markov trace into a spectral expansion over partitions. The trace reassembles class functions directly from these non-commutative Fourier coefficients.

The identification introduces no new physics. The mechanism is that the mass formula evaluates specific physical channels by selecting isolated partitions from the non-commutative spectrum. The identification governs the Pieri-shift dynamics of the Hecke photon and the spectral distribution of the archimedean remainder.
